# amNewYork

> > amNewYork is a New York City-focused news and media outlet covering local sports, sports betting promotions, and NYC-area teams including the Mets, Knicks, and Nets.

The site provides comprehensive coverage of New York sports teams, college athletics, and major sporting events, with a significant focus on sports betting promotional offers from major sportsbooks. amNewYork serves as a resource for NYC residents seeking local sports news and betting opportunities.
